open(p,'w').write('''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # The vertical three-color stamp is copied at each isolated marker pixel.
    bg=max(set(x for r in grid for x in r), key=lambda x:sum(v==x for r in grid for v in r))
    pts=[(i,j,grid[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j]!=bg]
    stamp=sorted([(i,j,c) for i,j,c in pts if c in (6,1,4)], key=lambda t:t[0])
    # input stamp 6,1,4 vertically; the 1 is its anchor
    markers=[(i,j) for i,j,c in pts if c==0]
    for i,j in markers:
        for dr,c in [(-1,6),(0,1),(1,4)]:
            if 0<=i+dr<h: out[i+dr][j]=c
    return out
''')
